parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the data migration, synchronization, or subscribe instance.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: JobType
parameters.description:
The node type of the DTS instance. Valid values:

- **MIGRATION**: data migration.
- **SYNC**: data synchronization.
- **SUBSCRIBE**: change tracking.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the data migration or synchronization instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: A special business-specific field. You do not need to pass this parameter.

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to release the reverse synchronization link only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description: A special business-specific field. You do not need to pass this parameter.
